g.title: ArthurRank6Convo2 begins.
g.text: ArthurRank6Convo2 begins.

g.title: j1021441573
g.text: I've been thinking. How many more of us do you think are out there?

g.title: j2890139917
g.text: Do you mean here in 1999, or in a broader sense?

g.title: j2028219684
g.text: "Us," meaning?

g.title: j3241181958
g.text: Both, I suppose. Here, now, in the past - in the future.

g.title: j2491418957
g.text: Protoframes. Here, or anywhere. Or any*when* I suppose.

g.title: j1244269784
g.text: Entrati made us with a purpose. With multiple purposes. It's clear it went past just the six of us.

g.title: j3624989469
g.text: At first, I thought he was making me "spare" warframes in case mine didn't come through the Helminth. Now, I'm not so sure.

g.title: j1873960535
g.text: I just wish I knew what he was up to. Or what his motivations really were, behind making more protoframes.

g.title: j2685867809
g.text: It made sense when there were just six of us.

g.title: j2036352833
g.text: Do you honestly believe his real motivation is to stop the Indifference?

g.title: j2837258461
g.text: Can we *really* trust him?

g.title: j907858451
g.text: I don't know, honestly. I don't trust him as far as I can throw him. And without a warframe, my throwing arm is shit.

g.title: j1584261894
g.text: No. We can't trust his motives any more than we can trust his methods.

g.title: j1283556711
g.text: Yeah. I don't agree with his methods all the time. But yeah. He wants to stop that thing.

g.title: j1434502464
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2244488359
g.text: He's trying to put the genie back in the proverbial bottle, if it can be done. And it's a messy process.

g.title: j4100988379
g.text: But we don't really have a choice, do we? All me and the kid can do is follow after him, cleaning up his messes.

g.title: j4116031178
g.text: Heh.

g.title: j1865582095
g.text: And we're the school caretakers, scrubbing the floors after him. Lovely.

g.title: j2386419850
g.text: Now that Kaya's got her own take on time travel, it might get easier for me to go back and forth.

g.title: j767798646
g.text: But I'm staying here, so it's up to the kid, now.

g.title: j3420897080
g.text: That kid's a pain in the arse sometimes, but I do appreciate that.

g.title: j161265069
g.text: Check boolean ArthurDating

g.title: j593157250
g.text: It's nice to know when you pop off to the shops... you might actually come back... :/

g.title: j1450783028
g.text: Eh. We'll see. I know you well enough, love. And I know you don't know when to keep your head down.

g.title: j161265069->j1450783028
g.text: true

g.title: j2949518413
g.text: Eh. We'll see. I know you well enough, Drifter. And I know you don't know when to keep your head down.

g.title: j161265069->j2949518413
g.text: false

g.title: j2613732724
g.text: Check boolean ArthurDating

g.title: j3357312339
g.text: It's one of the reasons I adore you as much as I do. ;)

g.title: j3869736365
g.text: It's one of the reasons I put up with having you around. ;)

g.title: j4077074198
g.text: I owe her a great deal, giving me some semblance of peace of mind. :)

g.title: j2613732724->j4077074198
g.text: true

g.title: j1875550791
g.text: An emoticon! :D

g.title: j2613732724->j1875550791
g.text: false

g.title: j85627564
g.text: Don't go getting all sappy on me.

g.title: j2613732724->j85627564
g.text: false

g.title: j3952597878
g.text: Yeah, yeah. Don't go getting used to it. It still feels weird.

g.title: j992397945
g.text: Mm, you know me. Crunchy on the outside, squishy in the middle. Like a stale version of those horrid pastries Amir and Velimir keep going on about.

g.title: j2196902107
g.text: Well, I'm flattered.

g.title: j3451054378
g.text: Tweebies?

g.title: j299714428
g.text: Anyway. Back on topic. Sometimes I get this sinking feeling that Entrati has a bigger purpose for us all.

g.title: j1308404632
g.text: What makes you say that?

g.title: j3114797017
g.text: Yeah, you might be right.

g.title: j1165299442
g.text: Could that just be wishful thinking?

g.title: j1249167697
g.text: The amount of effort he's put in to creating us? And the fact that there are more than just the six...

g.title: j3631249275
g.text: What do you think it is? And what is he waiting for?

g.title: j2193818460
g.text: What do you mean?

g.title: j3716544984
g.text: You don't build weapons like these unless you know you're going to use them, mate.

g.title: j3678796328
g.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_SHRUG>

g.title: j3047666253
g.text: I wish I knew, on both fronts.

g.title: j287211398
g.text: Sometimes it's hard to think that you're no longer "important."

g.title: j634852241
g.text: Well, I'm just saying that... maybe you don't want to feel abandoned by him.

g.title: j3226163207
g.text: Unless you *know* there's going to be a war.

g.title: j3615700606
g.text: Maybe he needs an army? Maybe he's trying to find "the one thing" he thinks can defeat the Indifference. Maybe a lot of things.

g.title: j2539069160
g.text: Right...

g.title: j736254899
g.text: That whatever he was here for, that whatever he did to you, still matters. Is still valid. That it didn't fail.

g.title: j451125157
g.text: Then all we can do is be prepared if that happens.

g.title: j2355107571
g.text: It's possible. But Entrati also seems to be the kind of person to have contingency plans.

g.title: j507512401
g.text: I don't know. Minerva and Velimir were telling me about the... "Cold War?" Sounds like people built a lot of crazy weapons and then never used them.

g.title: j2751101679
g.text: Can't help but think we're bullets in a gun. Meant to be used. Spent. And thrown away.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j2955908420
g.text: And to be clear, you still matter.

g.title: j3759716954
g.text: And to be clear, you still matter to *me.*

g.title: j2949633280
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2621144779
g.text: Maybe.

g.title: j2746105722
g.text: Fair counter point. But that's between countries, involving diplomacy. Moving parts.

g.title: j3133326661
g.text: I wish I could tell you. But I will do everything I can to stop that from happening.

g.title: j2193069126
g.text: You don't think you're done yet?

g.title: j648814371
g.text: But to think your story ends here, without a part to play in how it all ends? That sucks.

g.title: j2322432679
g.text: But maybe it hurts to think you've been replaced by Arthur 2.0 out there somewhere.

g.title: j1697574406
g.text: But maybe you just want your sacrifices to still matter in a more cosmic sense?

g.title: j103181199
g.text: Agreed.

g.title: j706507189
g.text: Part of me does hope more of us exist out there. But if they do end up coming here? We might end up needing a bigger mall.

g.title: j3874687273
g.text: This is between a literal god and a man who thinks he's one.

g.title: j3746804497
g.text: I know you will. And we'll face that day together, and I have confidence in that.

g.title: j4215329095
g.text: No. You don't build weapons like these unless you know you're going to use them, mate.

g.title: j554937186
g.text: That might be a part of it. If the Indifference is a reason I'm like this? And had to go through this?

g.title: j3754490517
g.text: Mate, I was ready to retire before I got sucked into this nonsense. Hardly.

g.title: j2158199146
g.text: Maybe. Maybe not. But how many people's sacrifices mean nothing, in life? Most.

g.title: j414765375
g.text: And hope that if any more of us show up here? We won't end up needing a bigger mall.

g.title: j3103847326
g.text: My money is on an inevitable collision. I don't think their egos would allow otherwise.

g.title: j2397353713
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3646513959
g.text: I don't know. Minerva and Velimir were telling me about the... "Cold War?" Sounds like people built a lot of crazy weapons and then never used them.

g.title: j616114508
g.text: I want a hand in bringing it down.

g.title: j2025388846
g.text: I am still astonished at your ability to utterly step in it, sometimes.

g.title: j3386930422
g.text: Maybe I'm just mourning the idea of a whole army of us out there, being made by a madman with no clear idea why. Or what for.

g.title: j3912848122
g.text: You might be right.

g.title: j3053530201
g.text: I really hope you're wrong.

g.title: j1648722223
g.text: Check boolean ArthurDating

g.title: j4253583776
g.text: Fair counter point. But that's between countries, involving diplomacy. Moving parts.

g.title: j3808525260
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2786024567
g.text: Being told to suffer and being told to sacrifice - with no clear idea why. Or what for.

g.title: j1121317034
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j343351729
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j532436438
g.text: Thanks, love.

g.title: j1648722223->j532436438
g.text: true

g.title: j2505493714
g.text: Thanks, Drifter.

g.title: j1648722223->j2505493714
g.text: false

g.title: j280682744
g.text: This is between a literal god and a man who thinks he's one.

g.title: j2521749123
g.text: I don't want to be abandoned as a footnote in history. I want to put this skana straight up its arse.

g.title: j1614735841
g.text: Maybe that's the pill I'm having a hard time swallowing, mate.

g.title: j3618504663
g.text: For what it's worth? I hope I'm not.

g.title: j373608574
g.text: For what it's worth? I hope I am.

g.title: j2069355391
g.text: My money is on an inevitable collision. I don't think their egos would allow otherwise.

g.title: j4196185503
g.text: I'll see what I can do. ;)

g.title: j715667738
g.text: You 'n me both. And maybe Entrati while we're at it.

g.title: j937801564
g.text: There are no victors in war. Only survivors.

g.title: j3021743804
g.text: Heh.

g.title: j2717944848
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3738824838
g.text: Check boolean ArthurDating

g.title: j507740716
g.text: Now you're talking.

g.title: j3738824838->j532436438
g.text: true

g.title: j3738824838->j2505493714
g.text: false
